{{Quote|We have a problem. The Empire is going to make a more aggressive move against the vacant structures littered around the galaxy. In effect, they're attempting to smoke us out of our hiding places.|Hoot|<ref name="seo">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68195&month=012009|text="Smoke 'Em Out"|int=Smoke 'Em Out}}</ref>}}
'''Hoot''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] who worked for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Hoot infiltrated the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] and served in it as a [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]]. When [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Brady]] was given the task of destroying vacant houses and structures across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], he met Hoot aboard a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] and told him of his plans. Hoot reported this back to [[General/Legends|General]] [[T. Morrow]], of the Alliance.
